entry.summary:

entry.title: WHO Announces New Ebola Vaccine Guidelines for the DRC
entry.summary:
UNITED NATIONS, September 4 (IPS) - While Uganda announced the end of its Ebola outbreak last week, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to battle its deadliest Ebola outbreak to date. As of September 1st, there have been over 6,000 cases, including over 3,000 deaths, with Ituri standing as the most affected province.

entry.title: Between the Reef and the Stars - A reflection on humanity’s twin longings
entry.summary:
VICTORIA, Seychelles, September 4 (IPS) - There is an older wisdom, quieter than the noise of our times, that whispers a simple truth: we are not the architects of nature, only its guests. Long before there were nations, economies, or even language, there was the pulse of the tide, the patience of coral, the breath of forests exchanging air with the sky. Into that ancient conversation we arrived — late, curious, and forgetful — mistaking our cleverness for sovereignty and our tools for wings.

Read the full story, “Between the Reef and the Stars - A reflection on humanity’s twin longings”, on globalissues.org →
